aboutMe.name: Alejo Suárez
aboutMe.description: <hl>Full Stack & Cloud Developer</hl> with experience building web and mobile applications, <hl>Google Cloud</hl> solutions and <hl>applied AI</hl>. I mainly work with Node.js, React and Python. Information Systems Engineering student at UTN FRBA.

cloud.title: Cloud Developer
cloud.subtitle: Hike · ABN Group
cloud.text: I build generative AI products and automations on Google Cloud. I develop multi-tenant platforms that integrate Gemini models through Vertex AI, content generation engines with automated output validation, and serverless services on Cloud Run that integrate with third-party APIs. I also work on infrastructure: deployments on Compute Engine behind load balancers, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and cloud migration proofs of concept.

adini.title: Co-Founder
adini.subtitle: ADINI
adini.text: Co-founder of ADINI, a software development agency. I design and build custom web and mobile applications, from requirements gathering with the client to deployment on Kubernetes. Among other clients, I provide services to Universidad Tecnológica Nacional, where I build a RAG-based AI assistant and its evolution into a multi-agent architecture.

developer.title: Software Developer
developer.subtitle: Universidad Tecnológica Nacional
developer.text: I developed and maintained the university's systems, managing every stage of the process—from analysis and design to implementation and deployment. I implemented new features and modules in existing systems and built applications from scratch, optimizing their performance and user experience. I also contributed to the platform's shared services, such as authentication with Keycloak, LDAP and the Traefik proxy.

analyst.title: Functional Analyst
analyst.subtitle: Universidad Tecnológica Nacional
analyst.text: Responsible for analyzing and determining requirements for software development projects. Focused on generating use cases and user stories, as well as creating various diagrams that comprised the analysis and design stages. In addition, I carried out QA testing tasks to guarantee the quality of the developed software.

support.title: Application Support
support.subtitle: Universidad Tecnológica Nacional
support.text: My role consisted of identifying and resolving errors in university applications both from the administrator interface and through database queries when necessary. Additionally, I managed app permissions and kept in touch with users to help them resolve issues.

utenia.title: UtenIA
utenia.tagline: An AI agent that answers with the university's documentation and each student's virtual campus data, with all inference running on its own servers.
utenia.description: A service syncs the institutional wiki, converts each page to markdown and generates its embeddings. Each question is expanded into several queries over a hybrid search in Qdrant, and a reranker picks the most relevant chunks. A supervisor agent decides on every turn whether to query the documentation, the virtual campus or both, through a custom Moodle tool service that filters each student's data on the server side.
utenia.role: full stack development of the RAG pipeline, the tool-calling agent, the Moodle tool service and the chat frontend.

sia.title: SIA
sia.tagline: The university's single portal: one login for every service, with a digital ID, payslips, mass communications with delivery tracking and built-in technical support.
sia.description: A React frontend with Keycloak single sign-on and permissions by role and affiliation, connected to an API that routes each request to the right microservice. It adds identity and email services on LDAP and Google Workspace, a ticketing system wired to the university's structure, and a queue-based mailing service: batched sends, per-sender limits, retries with backoff and the final status of every mailing.
sia.role: development of the portal frontend, the aliases, areas and translations modules, and the mass mailing service, with queues, retries and tracking for every delivery.

moviltrack.title: Moviltrack
moviltrack.tagline: Quotes, orders, delivery notes and payments in a single flow, with automatic recurring charges and expiration notices, and each project's profitability in plain sight.
moviltrack.description: An approved quote becomes an order in one click and is tracked through its delivery note, invoice and payment. Documents are generated as PDFs in the company's format, monthly services create their own charges, and every license notifies the customer before it expires. A dashboard shows sales, profit and active projects, with roles, two-factor authentication and continuous deployment on Azure.
moviltrack.role: full stack development of the system, from the API and PDF documents to the executive dashboard.

rip.title: RIP Alive
rip.tagline: An iOS and Android app to leave everything in order: vital data one QR scan away in an emergency, and a complete legacy that beneficiaries only see when the time comes.
rip.description: A single codebase published on the App Store and Google Play, with biometric unlock and push notifications. Each holder has a QR code with their vital data for emergencies, and beneficiaries access the legacy through a countdown: if the holder doesn't respond in time, the information is released automatically. It includes store subscriptions, coupons, a shop with shipping and a web admin panel.
rip.role: development of the app, the backend and the admin panel, with subscriptions, payments and a store.

sicyt.title: SICYT
sicyt.tagline: Research projects, teams and researcher categorization in a single platform, with the regulations validated automatically.
sicyt.description: A domain model with projects, members, roles, periods and documents, and a year-versioned rules engine that validates each project against the regulations that apply to it. The researcher categorization workflow moves through stages and batches with its full history, notifications go out through queues without blocking the user, and listings export to Excel or PDF.
sicyt.role: full stack development of the domain model, the year-versioned rules engine, the categorization workflow and queued notifications.

production.title: LLMs in production
production.text: Integration of models from different providers and open-source models on self-hosted infrastructure, with streaming and structured output. Every response is validated before reaching the user with deterministic checks and a judge model.

rag.title: RAG
rag.text: Construction of a complete retrieval pipeline: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search over a vector database and reranking, with models served on self-hosted infrastructure and prompts evaluated against question sets.

agents.title: Agents
agents.text: Development of a multi-agent architecture with a supervisor that decides which tool to use on each turn, each one an internal service with its own authorization. Daily work with coding agents using CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks and subagents, in a spec, TDD and review workflow.
